description: Bespoke / made-to-measure tailoring site for Nairobi, Kenya.
notes: critical_paths is intentionally empty in Phase 1: no auth, no payments, no live-database migrations.
Phase 2 will add auth/, lib/payments/, firestore.rules to critical_paths — those get standing-only-sized changes and extra review.
append_only_dirs means route folders under app/ only ever gain new files/routes; existing route files are not removed in Phase 1.
protected paths are this session's walking-skeleton output. A later batch session may only touch a protected path if the human owner names that exact file in their request.
